name: The Three-Law Primer
summary: The mortal tier's whole curriculum: physical, life and qi, taught as a closed list rather than a foundation. It exists because a three-slot frame cannot carry a fourth subject, so a pupil who wants to know what his world is missing has to go up the stair - and cannot afford to.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a curriculum that is a budget rather than a syllabus
authored-game-data:cosmology.mortal_law_availability seats three groups and names elemental, spatial and temporal as unwritten
lore search primer / curriculum / mortal-tier returned no prior knowledge record

attributes.seat_map: cosmology.mortal_law_availability seats physical, life and qi and leaves elemental, spatial and temporal unwritten, so the list has three entries and cannot be extended at this tier
attributes.taught_by: visitors. cosmology.mortal_world licenses plant and beast only, so no resident is licensed to hold office or to teach, which politics.visitor_office states from the other end
attributes.why_it_cannot_be_taught_above: the same three subjects on a six-slot frame are a third of the composition, and a pupil brought up on this primer reads a fuller world as having nothing wrong with it. That failure is why the stair school is a school and not a channel
attributes.what_it_costs_the_pupil: a gate fee. economy.gate_fee is the tier's only tax and it charges admission, so the primer is the one body of knowledge on the plains that everybody pays twice for - once to learn it and once to watch somebody else use it
attributes.what_a_graduate_may_not_do: state the list as complete. It is a property of the frame rather than of cultivation, and graduates who claim otherwise are why the tier is described in three subjects by people who have never been above the ridge

name: The Tide Timetable
summary: A breakthrough calendar, and the only technology in the setting that needs three separate things to exist before it can: a written temporal law, a written qi law, and a working spirit stone bed. It is therefore unreachable below the Spirit Peaks, which is why the mortal ladder is attempted rather than planned.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a timetable is only possible where the world's own cycle is legible and the fuel is purchasable
authored-game-data:cosmology.qi_tide is an authored law value moving through its range, and game/data ships a channel and recovery elixir per realm gate

attributes.three_preconditions: cosmology.temporal_law written so a cycle can be named, cosmology.qi_law written so the cycle moves a thing worth spending, and economy.spirit_stone_bed worked so there is a face to time the spend against
attributes.what_it_buys: the difference between attempting a gate and being scheduled for one. On a six-slot frame the second is available and on a three-slot frame it is not
attributes.why_the_plains_cannot_have_it: geography.mortal_plains seats no temporal law at all, so the only cycle the ground offers is the single annual flood, and a flood cannot be timed to a dose
attributes.the_mortal_substitute: cultures.plain_dweller hang festivals off a measured flood post and contracts run to the flood, which is a schedule with one tick a year rather than the sixty-four the method assumes
attributes.what_it_cannot_do: move a body between tiers. economy.ladder_price holds that nothing breaks the ladder between tiers, and a conversion needing two bodies to survive the crossing is the crossing tariff rather than a rate
attributes.who_keeps_it: nobody publishes the whole table. economy.gale_window publishes a season's hours and economy.spirit_stone_bed publishes a measured figure before any sale, and between them a holder can read the price without ever being handed the schedule

name: The Scar Lexicon
summary: A vocabulary for what a technique does at a place where the law it needs is unwritten: not weaker, but failing at full strength, which is the only reading that tells a hole from a handicap. It was written by migrants on the road, for migrants, because a body whose technique merely weakens is indistinguishable from a weak practitioner.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a diagnostic vocabulary authored by the displaced rather than by the institutions
authored-game-data:cosmology.law_scar is the place a law used to be written and no longer is

attributes.what_it_records: the shape a body's failure takes when the group it needs is absent, named per discipline. The naming is the contribution: an unlabelled failure is indistinguishable from a weak practitioner
attributes.who_writes_it: nobody owns it. history.migration_the_peak_ascent moved a population up the stair and the vocabulary accumulated on the road, so it is revised by whoever arrived next and there is no edition
attributes.the_measurement_it_replaces: a bench. organizations.gap_school takes a body to a frame that lacks a group and watches the technique fail at full strength rather than at reduced strength, and the lexicon is the label applied to what the bench returns
attributes.what_it_cannot_be_used_for: proving a claim. A scar is evidence that a frame was missing something, not evidence of how much, so a lexicon entry cannot be cited in a court or a seat trial
attributes.who_may_not_hold_it: nobody is forbidden it, which is the finding. The lexicon survives at every tier including the one that would prefer not to have it, because a diagnostic that names a hole is equally useful to the party that put it there

name: The Iron Cage Recipe
summary: The one craft the mortal tier is trusted with: caging a forming core in iron. Because the knowledge is intact and the ore is not, this is the clearest demonstration here that a method can outlive the resource that justified it and still be useless.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a craft that outlives the only material that justified it
authored-game-data:worlds.hollow_baseline seats physical 1.4 as the one slot that could cage a core, and economy.iron_ore_bed names the exhaustion permanent

attributes.what_it_makes: a cage of iron for a forming core, and nothing else. worlds.hollow_baseline spends its middle physical seat on exactly this and leaves the range the recipe has no answer to
attributes.why_it_is_the_only_craft_here: the mortal resource list holds one dense material and one herb, so the tier's entire craft output is one metal in one use
attributes.what_killed_the_supply: history.disaster_the_iron_grief. A world with no spatial law cannot open fresh rock, so an exhausted seam is a closed total rather than a rate of consumption
attributes.why_it_cannot_be_relocated: the next material that will cage a body is spirit stone and it does not exist below the spirit tier, so the ladder has no rung between. A recipe that needs a denser cage than the frame can hold has nowhere to go
attributes.the_migration_it_caused: history.migration_the_peak_ascent. The answer to the exhaustion was to leave, and the people who left carried this knowledge up with them, which is why the spirit tier has no shortage of craft and a shortage of hands

name: The Composition Survey
summary: The method behind the Law Census: count the groups a frame has actually seated, not the groups its tier is allowed to apply, because the difference between the two is what a mortal world spends its whole life inside without ever knowing. It is the most useful thing in the setting and the reason nobody publishes it.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a method that is enormously valuable and institutionally suppressed
authored-game-data:history.discovery_the_law_census separates a law's applicable tier list from the slot that is actually installed

attributes.the_distinction_it_makes: a slot is one law written at one value into one layer, so counting laws against seats counts imprints and not distinct laws. The survey's first step is to stop conflating the two, and history.discovery_the_law_census is this method run once across every frame anybody could reach
attributes.what_it_settles: whether a limitation is a discipline or a budget. history.discovery_the_realm_nine_verdict exists because the survey can produce that sentence and nothing else can
attributes.who_would_be_harmed: everybody who is currently owed an explanation. A mortal frame that seats three of six groups is not a failed world, it is a specific and permanent arrangement, and the people living inside it are the last to be told
attributes.why_it_is_not_published: the survey's output is a prediction. It says where a technique will fail and where a border will reject a body, and both predictions are the property of whoever holds the ground on the far side
attributes.the_door_it_opens: cosmology.three_dao_split. Three Daos is the largest number of coherent readings a six-slot frame can hold, so a survey that reads composition explains the split without ever needing a seventh law

name: The Slack Reading
summary: Holding one law reading apart from its effect long enough to observe it, which needs imprints the frame can spare and nobody has to hold. Only a fifteen-slot composition has that slack, so the discipline exists at exactly one tier and has no second home to be exported to.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:an observation that needs surplus capacity to exist at all
authored-game-data:worlds.patient_hold seats fifteen imprints over six groups across three layers and names the surplus as the only slack

attributes.what_it_needs: room. Reading a law rather than obeying one requires the frame to be crowded enough that one imprint can be held apart from what it is doing, and no other composition in the setting is crowded that way
attributes.which_budget_can_pay: fifteen seats over six groups across three layers. Ten seats is the first layered frame and its surplus is a load rather than a resource, so three groups can be gathered there but not separated
attributes.the_price: a lifetime per reading, because cosmology.temporal_law runs ten to a hundred times a mortal's rate. That is why organizations.held_hour_assembly is small and old rather than large and staffed
attributes.who_may_do_it: the office that tends the floor and nobody it explains the floor to. The skill is not teachable at a cheaper price because the clock charges by the repetition
attributes.what_it_produces: one observation of one group, published as nothing. history.era_the_still_point is the era whose mechanical content is holding a single reading past the life of any civilisation that has existed

name: The Layer Arithmetic
summary: Knowing which layer of a frame you are standing on, and therefore which law list is reading you. It exists because ten imprints cannot fit one layer's six groups, so the immortal tier was forced to be layered and every law claim above it depends on naming the layer first.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a competence that appears exactly where a budget overflows its own layer
authored-game-data:cosmology.immortal_law_availability forces a second layer, and worlds.nine_seats_court seats six imprints on the surface and four on the shelf above

attributes.the_arithmetic: a layer is one region carrying its own law list and its own share of the volume, so ten imprints over six groups cannot be a single list. Six sit on the surface, four on the shelf above, and the second four are the strongest writing of any group in the tier
attributes.what_it_changes_about_a_claim: everything. A law is written at a value into a layer, so a claim about a law with no layer named is a claim about a number that exists nowhere
attributes.where_it_is_taught: worlds.nine_seats_court and nowhere below it. Under the Spirit Peaks a frame has one layer, so the arithmetic has nothing to operate on and is not taught at a mortal school at any price
attributes.why_it_matters_to_two_tiers: history.consequence_the_density_ceiling is a layer fact. A maximally dense fixed body stops at realm seventeen because a complete composition has no duplicated group left to open the cavity it needs, and duplication only exists where a group is written twice

name: The Seventh Seat Method
summary: The procedure for seating a seventh law into a vacant slot, kept as a searchable name precisely because it was attempted and cannot afterwards be told from an empty seat. The office that names vacancies is exactly the one that could detect a second attempt, and exactly the one forbidden the method.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a forbidden procedure preserved as a name because a name that can be searched cannot be proposed twice
authored-game-data:worlds.seventh_ward records the consumed slot and history.collapse_the_refused_seating records the loss

attributes.what_it_proposes: put a seventh law group into one of the immortal tier's unfillable seats. There are six groups and the method needs one that does not exist, so the slot is spent holding an absence
attributes.what_it_cost: the seat, permanently and invisibly. After the attempt it cannot be told from an empty one, so the loss is both total and undetectable, and the four unfillable seats above it can never again be certified empty
attributes.the_enforcing_institution: organizations.nine_seat_notary, whose entire content is the three-state vocabulary of a seat that does not exist, a seat that exists and is vacant, and a seat that is held. An office that must keep the second state distinct is the one body that would have to notice the method being used
attributes.why_the_office_is_the_right_one: it may name a seat and may not take one, and it observes from the second layer where the surplus imprints are actually written. It is therefore the least interested party in a new occupant and the best placed to see one
attributes.what_is_recorded_instead: worlds.seventh_ward, a noun with no coordinates. The honest record of the failure is a name, and the name is the enforcement: nobody spends a seat on an absence a second time

name: Borrowed Absence
summary: Running a technique on a group the frame has not written, which injures a body rather than slowing it. It is a licensed experiment at one academy and a capital offence everywhere else, because the price is a hole shaped like the discipline and the graduate carries it with nobody left to describe it.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a licensed experiment whose price is paid in the experimenter rather than in equipment
authored-game-data:organizations.gap_school spends a body per experiment and holds the record of what was missing from which of its graduates

attributes.what_it_does_to_a_body: cosmology.unwritten_law has no process on it, no substance carrying it and no life form licensed by it, so a body that draws on one anyway is injured rather than slowed. The result is a scar shaped like the discipline and permanent
attributes.the_licence: organizations.gap_school, which may take a student to a frame where a required group is unwritten and may not let them do it twice. One body per experiment is the whole of the college's ethics
attributes.who_may_perform_it: graduates of one college, once, under supervision. Nobody else may, and the prohibition is not enforced by anybody with a weapon - it is enforced by the fact that the method cannot be taught from a text
attributes.the_cost_that_is_not_avoidable: a graduate who stops attending keeps the scar and loses the record. The college owns the account of what was removed; the body is left carrying the hole and no longer has anyone who can tell them what shape it is
attributes.why_it_cannot_be_taught_from_a_text: the observation requires a frame the reader is not in. Every written account of it is a report, and a report cannot be followed by somebody who has never been to a place where a law is unwritten

name: Naming the Density Ceiling
summary: The explanation for why the densest bodies in the setting stop at realm seventeen, one gate short of their own tier. Every holder of a working face profits from that hole staying a hole, and the assay floor publishes measured stone before any sale precisely so that nobody has to be told the reason.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a suppressed explanation that somebody is paid not to have
authored-game-data:history.consequence_the_density_ceiling is unresolved, and economy.spirit_stone_bed states that nobody may sell the answer

attributes.what_it_would_explain: worlds.tithe_remainder is a complete six-group composition over six hundred units with nothing doubled, and a maximally dense fixed body stops at seventeen because there is no duplicated group left to open the cavity it needs. That is a composition result, not a discipline failure, and nobody present could see it
attributes.who_gains_from_its_absence: anybody holding a working face. The measured stone per unit worked has been falling for three generations and the densest buyers are exactly the people who would stop buying if the ceiling were a fact about the rock rather than about them
attributes.the_enforcement_mechanism: civilizations.quarry_company runs the assay floor as neutral ground and publishes the measured figure before any sale. A figure published before the sale cannot be disputed after it, and nobody is thereby required to state a reason
attributes.the_cost_of_saying_it: a practitioner at realm fourteen would learn that the ladder they are standing on has a published end. That is the real cost of the explanation and the reason it is not merely expensive
attributes.why_it_matters_to_a_single_person: history.consequence_the_density_ceiling is still there and still unexplained by anyone who was not there. The unnamed thing is therefore the only thing in this setting that every living person at this tier has in common and none of them can talk about

name: The Sixth Reading
summary: What the Held Note floor is actually a reading of, and who holds the office whose central etiquette is refusing to explain it, because a frame crowded enough that a law can be held apart from its effect is the one condition under which a law can be answered. One floor, one lifetime per observation.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a secret enforced by professional etiquette rather than by a threat
authored-game-data:worlds.the_held_note presses fifteen imprints into one held value, and organizations.held_hour_assembly is forbidden to explain the floor

attributes.what_it_is: the sixth reading, which is to say the observation that a crowded frame makes possible and that no cheaper frame permits. It is not a seventh law; it is the first place a law is seen doing its work
attributes.the_enforcement_institution: organizations.held_hour_assembly, whose refusal to explain the floor to a visitor is the office's central etiquette and the only thing about it anybody outside is permitted to be told
attributes.why_etiquette_is_the_enforcement: the office is small and old and staffed by the only people who have stayed long enough to hold a reading. There is nothing to arrest anybody with, so the practice is the enforcement and the practice is sustained by nobody wanting to be the one who broke it
attributes.the_price_of_a_single_reading: a lifetime. The clock at this tier runs ten to a hundred times a mortal's, so the office's whole scale is set by how long one honest observation takes
attributes.what_the_practitioners_are_permitted_to_: that the floor is being held. Anything further is the refusal, and the refusal is not a courtesy attached to the work - it is the condition under which the work counts

name: The Tenth Gate Recipe
summary: A procedure that would carry a mortal frame one gate past its own ceiling, forbidden because one office's entire content is the record that the ceiling was never issued. The strongest evidence against it is a body that reached the twenty-ninth gate and has never come back to describe the thirtieth.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a crime defined by the existence of the record that forbids it
authored-game-data:races.unwritten reaches the twenty-ninth gate and nobody has described the thirtieth, and history.discovery_the_realm_nine_verdict made the ceiling a limit nobody was issued

attributes.what_it_claims: that a third-seat frame can carry one more gate than its life seat was spent on. geography.mortal_plains is physical, life and qi with no spare, so the claim is arithmetic rather than discipline and would need the composition to be wrong
attributes.the_enforcing_institution: organizations.field_registry, the mortuary college that reads the dead as the frame said rather than as the village remembers. Its whole content is that a life is also the record of a gate that was never available, so a recipe breaking that ceiling makes every list it has kept a lie
attributes.the_evidence_against_it: races.unwritten, the only body in the record that has kept passing gates its world cannot inscribe. It reaches the twenty-ninth and does not return, which is not a refutation and is the reason nobody can sign the recipe
attributes.what_the_registry_records_instead: a life against the ceiling its frame had already spent before the person was born. That is a different genre of document and it is the genre the setting actually has
attributes.why_it_must_not_be_held: an office that keeps a burnt list is the one place a recipe would be found, and an office whose entire legitimacy is that the limit is real cannot also be the place the limit is negotiable

name: The Echo Ward Survey Books
summary: Every survey taken of the ground around the collapsed pocket, and all of them are still there. The books are neither destroyed nor readable: two competent surveys of the same ground now disagree by more than the ordinary disagreement, so the record survives as a set of incompatible figures.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a record lost to being self-contradictory rather than to fire
authored-game-data:worlds.echo_of_the_ward tore the parent frame along the cut, and geography.exhausted_seam is the scar nobody will hold a claim on

attributes.how_it_was_lost: the carve tore the parent frame because it was made from outside, and a torn frame no longer agrees with itself. Nothing burned. The books are complete and mutually exclusive
attributes.what_a_reader_can_extract: the boundary of the disagreement, which is the one useful figure in the stack. A reader can say the ground is not measurable here and can say precisely how far the two readings part company
attributes.why_it_is_still_here: cultures.blind_survey keeps records by ear, and sound survives a frame that has failed in a way a measured distance does not. The stack is the only survey archive on the plains that a failing frame could not corrupt
attributes.the_durable_lesson: that a seat cannot be taken by writing harder. worlds.first_ward_chamber succeeded because it was cut from inside by somebody already holding the frame, at a value below what tore
attributes.who_keeps_the_stack: nobody is paid to. It is read when a claim is contested on ground nobody will hold, which is frequent enough that the reading has a name and rare enough that the stack has never been collated

name: The Glasskin Anneal Ledger
summary: The working method for holding a vitrified body, and the reason no glasskin has been born since. A frame raised its physical law to make material harder and every existing body failed in one night, so the only copy of how to stop it happening died with the people who had it.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a single-copy method destroyed together with the population that kept it
authored-game-data:races.glasskin vitrified at maturity and failed at once when physical law was retuned, and races.cinderkin is the clearest evidence an element is a process

attributes.what_it_recorded: temperatures, orders and cooling times for a body that had stopped ageing because it had stopped being tissue, kept by the only population that could read the result as a result rather than as a corpse
attributes.the_night_it_ended: cosmology.physical_law was raised to make material harder. An unwritten group has three signatures and a retuned one has three consequences: every body vitrified earlier than it did had nothing left to re-crystallise
attributes.why_there_is_no_second_copy: the population that held the method was the population that failed, and it was not a large one. A technique whose only readers were its own subjects dies with them and leaves no partial version
attributes.what_survives_as_practice: cultures.ash_register, which records a recovery in public and never displays the fragments again. It is the closest available habit and it is four hundred years too late to be the same thing
attributes.what_it_is_the_cleapest_proof_of: that a law is a dial rather than a switch, and that the setting's record can be destroyed by an improvement

name: The Unwritable Price Sheet
summary: The price list of a settlement that concluded, correctly, that a figure it wrote down would be the first thing anyone used to justify taking its cargo - and then, because a Void Serpent's value cannot be written at all, drove its own qi past the ceiling of its law trying to settle the accounts. The sheet is gone with the frame; the refusal survived as a culture.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a document destroyed by the arithmetic it refused to record
authored-game-data:worlds.the_unwritable_ledger drove qi past the authored ceiling and the settlements abandoned the ledger first

attributes.what_it_refused_to_state: the price of the Void Serpent trade, in the community's own weight. A Void Serpent's law values write a number that cannot be recorded, so the settlement declined to price its most profitable cargo rather than hand over the first weapon against itself
attributes.how_the_frame_ended: worlds.the_unwritable_ledger is the same settlement's frame. Qi at 118 against an authored ceiling of 100 means the group stopped holding, the outline was left exposed, and the tear it opened met a world it agreed with on nothing
attributes.what_the_refusal_became: cultures.weight_and_name, which never recovered a price list and now holds nobody makes the first offer. The habit outlived the document by four centuries and is still load-bearing
attributes.why_it_is_the_only_loss_that_became_a_cu: every other loss here destroyed a capability. This one destroyed a habit of writing and the habit's absence became an institution, which is the only way a lost text can be more useful than the text was
attributes.who_still_asks_for_it: nobody, and that is the finding. A community whose vocabulary contains no word for price has no procedure for reading the sheet even if it were found, so its loss cost nothing and its refusal cost everything

name: The Cinder Famine Dosage Tables
summary: Dosing schedules for a population whose fuel was its own body, kept by the households that had the tables and ate the medicine first. A bad grazing year is a medical shortage before it is a hunger, so the tables were consumed by the crisis they existed to answer.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a technical record destroyed by the resource it rationed
authored-game-data:economy.scrub_commons puts a medical shortage before a hunger, and history.disaster_the_cinder_famine thinned the population at the rate it could not stop

attributes.what_they_set_out: dose, interval and floor for herb_common against a furnace body with no elemental law seated beneath it. Every discharge such a body makes is paid in flesh, so the schedule was the only thing standing between a breakthrough and an autopsy
attributes.why_the_keepers_had_none: the commons is medicine, feed and calories at once, and the grazers come first because the herds are larger than the households. The tables were written by people whose own stock they were rationing
attributes.the_order_the_failures_came_in: herb, then protein, then attention. The third is the one the register kept: people who had been dosed correctly and were still failing, and whose households therefore knew the tables and had none
attributes.what_replaced_them: cultures.deadwatch holds the year's dead together as a declared group instead of storing the long-lived, which is a worse instrument for the purpose and is the reason nobody rebuilt the tables
attributes.who_keeps_the_shape_of_the_gap: cultures.cinder_mark, the households still eating by the rules of the year there was nothing to eat. They hold the allocation without the arithmetic, which is the most durable form a lost table takes

name: The First Ward Warden Line
summary: The succession record of the pocket where a warden pays a fourth law seat out of their own body every period. There is no temporal law inside it, so nothing in the chamber is dated and tenure is counted in the holder's own breathing; the line was never written down and cannot now be reconstructed.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a record lost because its frame had no clock to write it against
authored-game-data:worlds.first_ward_chamber leaves temporal law vacant and pays the fourth seat out of the warden's own reserve

attributes.what_it_had_to_record: who held the fourth imprint, for how long, and what each of them spent. The reading returns the same number afterwards, so the cost never falls and never shows up as a wound that would heal
attributes.the_absent_law_that_did_it: cosmology.temporal_law is still vacant in the pocket, so nothing inside is dated. The warden's tenure is counted in their own breathing, and a line measured in one person's breathing cannot be handed to a successor's
attributes.why_the_cost_never_shows: a period of upkeep is paid out of the holder's body every period and the reading is unchanged afterwards. There is no scar and no ledger line, so the succession has to be argued from what the holder can no longer do
attributes.what_a_successor_must_infer: which of the holder's remaining capacities was the one being spent. That is a question about a body and not about a document, which is why the line cannot be recovered by anybody who did not hold the pocket
attributes.who_claims_the_line: several houses and none of them can produce it. organizations.wide_door is built on the fact that a body already sold across a tear cannot be recalled to this side of it

name: The Stair School
summary: The school on the one-way stair, and the only school on the plains that has never produced a graduate who lives there. It teaches to visitors because the tier licenses no humanoid, so every teacher arrived from above, every pupil pays a gate fee to be taught what the gate fee is for, and none of them can stay.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:an institution that exists because the population it serves is not resident
authored-game-data:geography.tier_stair is the only route, and politics.visitor_office defines an office class that can only be filled by non-residents

attributes.who_teaches: nobody local. cosmology.mortal_world licenses plant and beast only, so every instructor on the plains is a visitor who paid to arrive and will pay to leave
attributes.who_pays: the pupil's household, and the town that chartered the gate. economy.gate_fee charges admission, so the school sells into the only revenue the tier has and its fees are indistinguishable from the gate's
attributes.what_it_exists_to_do: turn a spectator into somebody who can be certified at the ring. The ring's roster is closed by law and not by fee, so the school is the only legitimate route onto it and it sells a certificate rather than a chance
attributes.why_it_has_no_alumni: cultures.plain_dweller treat tenure as a queue and the region cannot afford a professional, so a graduate takes the stair or takes a share. There is no third outcome and the school is not sorry
attributes.what_a_graduate_does_next: history.migration_the_peak_ascent. The answer to history.disaster_the_iron_grief was to leave, and the school is the only place the leaving was decided rather than suffered
attributes.what_it_may_not_teach: anything requiring a group the frame does not write. The school teaches cultivation nothing, which is why every technique on the plains is held by a visitor

name: The Published Unwritten Chamber
summary: A house that publishes its method in full - technique, attendance, a chamber to practise in - and takes discretion in return, so what is done inside is neither written nor repeated. Teaching at that level of disclosure is the only thing a house with something to hide can safely do.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a school whose transparency is the concealment mechanism
authored-game-data:organizations.quiethouse publishes teaching against discretion, and politics.exclusivity_petition is the unanswered conflict that produces

attributes.what_is_published: technique, attendance and a chamber. All three are checkable by a stranger and none of them is the house's actual advantage, which is who has been in the room and for how long
attributes.what_is_not: results. Nothing done inside the house is written down and not repeated, so a reader can copy the method perfectly and cannot tell whether the house's practice is better than the reader's
attributes.the_exchange: discretion for access. A guest who repeats what was done inside is refused the chamber, and the house survives because the sanction is the one thing a practitioner cannot replace
attributes.why_the_road_objects: cultures.passage_livery needs a credential that is legible without being recorded, and a published exclusivity that is unfalsifiable is a credential only the house can read
attributes.what_a_graduate_carries: a method and no standing. There is no certificate a third party can verify, because the house has arranged never to publish the one thing that would make its own teaching checkable
attributes.the_cost_of_talking: politics.exclusivity_petition is unanswered and that is the cost. Two published exclusivities now govern the same traveller and neither derives from the other

name: The Heap Lift
summary: The one job on the plains that cannot be done without being taught, taught on a spoil heap by the weight moved rather than by instruction, because there is no school and no wage and the tools are consumed by the cleanup rather than by the product.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a competence with no institution behind it and a guild that must therefore own its own
authored-game-data:economy.spoil_hauler states the profession is genuinely scarce and that there is no school for it

attributes.what_is_taught: the lift. A body that cannot hold a loaded barrow level for a shift cannot be taught at all, and the teaching is four days of hauling somebody else's heap while somebody else corrects the grip
attributes.how_it_is_taught: by demonstration on the heap, counted by the tonnage a crew has moved rather than by any assessment. organizations.spoilwright keeps the public tally and a crew that reads it knows what it is worth
attributes.why_there_is_no_school: the only tools on this tier are iron tools, and a hauler spends them on moving material that pays nothing. A school would have to be paid in the one currency the work destroys
attributes.what_a_defector_owes: the heap they did not move. organizations.spoilwright keeps the tally up, so a defector's name sits against a number that only goes down and is followed for life
attributes.who_can_teach_it: anybody currently hauling. This is the constraint that makes the profession scarce: capacity has to be bought from organizations.ironpact, whose roster answers a standing order and cannot supply an urgent face shift

name: The Two Calendars of the Plains
summary: One region, two incompatible reckonings: a flood post everybody agrees on and an exact day-count that exists only because one frame spent its third law seat on a clock and got no life. Which calendar a contract is written in decides whether it can be disputed at all.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:two competing standard times created by two different law budgets in one region
authored-game-data:worlds.long_count spent temporal law and left life law vacant, and what it left behind is the dating convention the Debt Line binds against

attributes.the_post_reckoning: a measured flood post, because geography.mortal_plains has no clock and the single annual flood is the only cycle the ground offers. Contracts run to the flood and a settlement on the watercourse is revocable once a generation
attributes.the_day_count: exact to the day, inherited from the frame that had a clock. It is the only exact reckoning below the Spirit Peaks and it is not the local one, because the frame it came from has no life on it and nothing there was ever farmed
attributes.where_the_day_count_came_from: worlds.long_count. The households that could afford the stair left first and took their record-books; the ones that could not were sealed in with them, which is why a precision instrument outlived every person who could use it locally
attributes.the_legal_consequence: a debt dated on the post can be disputed for a season. A debt dated on the day-count can only be disputed on arithmetic, so choosing the calendar is choosing whether the contract can be argued about at all
attributes.who_uses_which: cultures.debt_line binds a child to a named debt before first breath is drawn cold, which requires a date worth binding. cultures.plain_dweller judge work by what survives the season, which requires a flood

name: The Two-Tide Table
summary: Timekeeping for a coast whose temporal law was never written: the clock drifts, so no date is the same twice and a schedule has to be published against two tides a day instead of a calendar. Every settlement on that shore speaks in high, low and turning because nothing else there is repeatable.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a calendar built from the only periodic event a frame guarantees
authored-game-data:cultures.shore_notice borrows its whole civic vocabulary from the shore for exactly this reason

attributes.why_a_calendar_cannot_be_kept: an unwritten temporal law means the clock drifts, so a date stated yesterday is not the date today. A community that needs a schedule cannot use an instrument that moves and must use one that repeats
attributes.what_the_tides_replace: the date. Two tides a day is a shorter interval than anybody wants to contract in, so the table is not a calendar but a way of saying when without saying which day
attributes.the_vocabulary_it_forces: nobody here is inside or outside, only high, low or turning. That is a timekeeping decision before it is a political one, and a settlement whose schedule runs on the tide cannot pretend a boundary is a fact
attributes.who_publishes_it: nobody centrally. It is the common property of the shore, which is why economy.gale_window can be published a season ahead on it and nobody can later claim the window was moved for them
attributes.what_it_cannot_settle: a boundary. The tideline moves and no table can fix it, so a claim held by water is held until the water goes somewhere else

name: Cairn Ring Marking
summary: How a trial ground is laid out on a frame that cannot say where anything is: a ring of standing markers spaced by ear and checked by sound, because possession on the plains is proven by a marker standing rather than by measuring where it stands.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a permanent installation designed around the measurement its world cannot support
authored-game-data:worlds.hollow_baseline states possession is proven by a marker standing, and cultures.blind_survey holds that an eye measurement is provisional

attributes.what_is_built: a ring of standing markers with a clear space inside it, so a trial can be judged by people at a distance and a claim can be pointed at rather than surveyed
attributes.how_it_is_spaced: by ear, then checked by sound. cosmology.unwritten_law means no two surveys of the same ground have ever agreed, and sound is the one instrument that returns a consistent answer in a frame whose geometry drifts
attributes.what_it_proves: that somebody is holding this ground now. The ring is continuously occupied and that occupancy is the entire evidence, because a marker that has been moved is not a smaller claim - it is no claim
attributes.what_it_cannot_prove: a boundary, and that is the ring's one permanent defect. An outside marker is heard from inside and there is nothing in the ground to say how far away it is
attributes.who_keeps_the_ring: organizations.watchgate, which holds no record of who watched and only a record of who paid. The brokers can read the ring's occupancy and cannot read its history, which is why the ring survives every change of management
attributes.what_the_spectators_are_actually_watchin: a practice on a marked floor. economy.gate_fee says a crowd with no stake in the outcome is the only economic relationship on the mortal tier with no obligation on either side, and the marking is what makes it a floor

name: The Failing Screen
summary: A screen built to fail at exactly the group the frame has not written, so the absence shows up as a legible gap in a wall instead of a hole in a person. Invented for bodies sent to be measured, and the reason a law scar is survivable as long as it stays visible from the inside.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a defensive structure whose defect is the specification
authored-game-data:organizations.gap_school sends bodies to frames lacking a group, and cultures.fluxwright builds art that is always one law short of being legible

attributes.what_it_is_for: turning a missing law group into a visible boundary. A body that runs on an absent group is injured; a wall built to fail at that same group is only a hole, and a hole can be pointed at
attributes.how_it_is_tuned: to the named group, at the value the frame actually holds. knowledge.scar_lexicon supplies the name and organizations.gap_school supplies the only ground on which the tuning can be observed rather than guessed
attributes.who_uses_it: anybody who has been somewhere a group was unwritten and come back with the scar. It is not licensed and it is not scarce, which is the difference between it and knowledge.borrowed_absence
attributes.why_it_is_never_the_same_shape_twice: the missing group differs by frame and by layer, so there is no pattern to copy. Every screen is a new design and the guilds that build them are the only people who have seen two
attributes.what_it_costs: the frame's own materials, which on a tier with one dense material means iron. A screen is therefore competing with a working face for the same ore, which is why the technique is common and the practice is not

name: The Broken-Law Logic
summary: Broken law is the only substrate that will host a self larger than its own body, so every trial needing a bigger practitioner than the frame licenses is fought on a failed imprint. It is why the mine and the trial compete for the same square metres and neither can be moved.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:an arena and an industry occupying one scar because nothing else will hold either
authored-game-data:geography.fragment_ring is a trial ring on geography.fragmentshelf, and cosmology.rift is the mechanism that makes two worlds adjacent

attributes.the_requirement_it_meets: a practitioner whose self exceeds the container it is in. cosmology.mind_dao needs spatial law read high enough for that arithmetic to work, which puts the requirement at the top of the setting rather than anywhere below it
attributes.why_the_mine_and_the_trial_share_it: cultivation.qi_transcendent cannot be attempted on a frame that will not hold the attempt, and an imprint that has failed will. The ground works for the trial and for the extraction of what the failure left, so neither party can relocate
attributes.what_it_costs_to_hold: a working face rather than a claim, exactly as organizations.quarrywright holds its seam. Possession of the trial is possession of the substrate and there is no second site
attributes.who_fights_on_it: cultivation.qi_transcendent and the double paths, because a dual practice gathers what a single one cannot and the ring is the only ground in the setting that will accept the assembly
attributes.why_it_cannot_be_relocated: a rift closes when the value returns in range, and a closed rift is not a floor. Any frame whose laws were retuned into range loses the arena, so the ring's tenancy is held on the continued failure of somebody else's arithmetic

name: Bitter Commons Dosing
summary: The mortal tier's only dependable remedy, and the dosing rule that decides who gets it first: grazers, always, because the herds are larger than the households and the commons has no defender except the people who can do without it, which is nobody.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:medicine that is rationed by an agricultural priority rather than by a clinical one
authored-game-data:economy.scrub_commons makes herb_common medicine, feed and caloric staple at once

attributes.the_three_uses: medicine, livestock feed and calories. geography.bitter_scrub grows all three off one plant, so every therapeutic decision on this tier is simultaneously a grazing decision and a household one
attributes.who_is_dosed_first: livestock. The herds are larger than the households, so the commons has no defender except people who can do without it, and there are none
attributes.why_medical_shortage_precedes_hunger: regrowth is limited by grazing pressure and not by weather, because nothing here is seasonally dormant. A bad year is therefore a herb shortage first, and a herb shortage kills the people the tier was already going to lose
attributes.the_substitute: none and no import, because there is no ladder rung below iron. geography.mortal_plains grows almost nothing worth carrying and every dose on this tier is cut from the same commons
attributes.what_a_practitioner_is_forbidden_to_do: to hold a dose back against a better case. The tier cannot afford a reserve, and an inventory of herb is a claim on somebody else's herd that will not survive the season it was made

name: The Channel Elixir Method
summary: How a breakthrough is prepared rather than attempted: a dose timed to the tide that will carry it, on a stone bed that holds qi. It is the first knowledge here that is bought rather than inherited, and because a tide cannot be read on any frame below the Spirit Peaks, so the method is worth nothing outside its own tier.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a preparation method that is a scheduling decision rather than a formula
authored-game-data:game/data ships a channel and a recovery elixir per realm gate, and economy.spirit_stone_bed makes a breakthrough schedulable

attributes.what_it_prepares: cultivation.qi_foundation and every gate above it that a body can enter but not hold. The dose does not confer a gate; it makes the tide arrive at a body that has already been prepared for it
attributes.what_it_needs_on_the_ground: a working spirit stone face and a readable tide, which is why the method is a spirit-tier knowledge and not an improvement on a mortal one. Below the ridge there is no stone, no temporal law and therefore no timetable to time to
attributes.the_published_timetable_it_follows: knowledge.tide_timetable, whose companion publication is economy.gale_window. A holder who claims not to know the price is claiming not to know the schedule, and both figures are the same number viewed from two sides
attributes.who_can_afford_it: anybody drawing on a claim. economy.immortal_essence_pool prices the top rung in periods rather than weight, so above the spirit tier this method becomes a debt schedule, and the schedule is what defaults
attributes.what_it_replaced: attempt. history.era_the_full_composition is the era in which a schedule has nothing to schedule around, and it ends at realm seventeen where a dense fixed body can no longer form the cavity it needs

name: Splint and Pressure Craft
summary: Mortal repair work, and the tier's reason for having a craft at all: iron tools here are consumed by clearing spoil rather than by making anything, so a broken limb is set by hand with the same method for a century and never improved, because improving it costs iron.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a technical tradition frozen by the opportunity cost of its one material
authored-game-data:cultivation.shared_bone_mending_splint and cultivation.shared_wound_pressure are the authored forms of exactly this work

attributes.what_is_repaired: bone and blood loss, by hand, with the same two techniques the setting has always had. cultivation.shared_bone_mending_splint sets the structure and cultivation.shared_wound_pressure controls what is lost, and between them they are the whole of mortal medicine
attributes.why_it_never_improves: economy.iron_ore_bed is a closed total on a frame that cannot open fresh rock. Every refinement of the craft consumes the same ore a working face needs, so improvement is a decision to leave ore in the ground
attributes.what_the_improvement_would_cost: one working face's worth of iron per generation, against a repair that works. geography.exhausted_seam is what happens when a tier chooses the ore instead, and the craft's stagnation is the alternative nobody chose
attributes.why_it_is_taught_by_kin: the tier cannot afford a professional. cultures.plain_dweller have the plough, the roof and the levy as three claims on the same hands, so a healer's children are the only people available at the moment the healer is needed
attributes.what_it_cannot_do: treat anything a furnace body does to itself. history.disaster_the_cinder_famine is a population whose fuel is its own body, and no splint reaches that

name: The Standing Weight
summary: The measuring discipline of a people whose civic vocabulary contains no word for price: weigh, never quote, and let nobody make the first offer, because a buyer who names a figure first forfeits standing for a season. The market polices itself and there is no office behind it.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a market's core competence is the refusal it has institutionalised
authored-game-data:economy.weight_standard states the unit is mass and the vocabulary contains no word for price

attributes.the_unit: mass, and only mass. A price is a claim about the future and a weight is a fact about the present, so the standing weight is the one measurement in this setting that cannot be used against its holder later
attributes.the_rule_that_replaces_a_price_list: nobody makes the first offer. A buyer who names a figure first forfeits standing in the market for a season, which is the whole enforcement mechanism and there is no office behind it
attributes.why_no_office_exists: no institution in that community could be captured by making itself useful, because usefulness here is a habit rather than a service anybody can be given a post to provide
attributes.what_it_cannot_do: be levied, taxed or quoted in a tariff, because no one will state the figure. That is precisely why this is the only road cultures.unfiled can afford and why a tariff quoted in weight rather than value is what made them reachable
attributes.how_it_survived_the_collapse: a Void Serpent's law values write a number that cannot be recorded, so the settlement abandoned the ledger rather than the trade. knowledge.unwritable_price_sheet is the document; this is the habit that outlived it

name: The Heap Tally
summary: A public count of spoil moved by every crew, kept where the crews can read it, and the only accounting the mortal tier can support - because it is a weight and not a distance, and on a frame with no spatial law no two measurements of a length have ever agreed.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:an accounting chosen because the alternative quantity is unmeasurable in this world
authored-game-data:organizations.spoilwright keeps a public tally of heap moved by each crew, and names it a weight and not a distance

attributes.what_is_counted: barrows and tonnage, by crew, updated daily, published on a board the crews can read without asking permission. Nothing about distance is recorded anywhere on the plains
attributes.why_a_weight_and_not_a_distance: cosmology.unwritten_law leaves spatial law vacant, so a length on this ground is not a stable quantity. A mass is. The tally is therefore not a simplification of the real quantity - it is the only quantity that is real
attributes.where_it_is_kept: in public, at the heap. An accounting a crew cannot read is an accounting a crew cannot be held to, and the guild's whole deterrent depends on being legible to the people it is deterring
attributes.what_it_is_used_to_settle: a debt of tonnage between a departing member and the heap they did not move, and a share of the face. Both are settled by weight, which is why haulers argue about the face and never about rates
attributes.what_it_cannot_record: how far anything is from anything, and therefore where the ore is. geography.exhausted_seam stays invisible to this document, which is why the working face and the audit are run by two guilds who do not speak

name: The Survey Disagreement Protocol
summary: The standing procedure for comparing two incompatible measurements of the same ground: neither is discarded, both are published, and the claim is settled by who can hold the line rather than by who read it right. It was written to make a stack of contradictory books usable, and because that failed, both figures are published instead of one.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:an institution built around a permanent measurement failure rather than around a temporary one
authored-game-data:worlds.hollow_baseline states no two surveys of the plains have ever agreed, and knowledge.echo_ward_survey_books is the stack that forced the rule

attributes.the_procedure: both figures are published with both surveyors named, neither is discarded and neither is averaged. Averaging two readings of a ground that cannot hold a length produces a third figure with no witness
attributes.why_both_are_kept: a discarded survey is a silent deletion and a silent deletion on ground that never agrees removes half the evidence every generation. Keeping both is the only way the accumulated record stays useful
attributes.what_settles_a_claim_then: occupancy. geography.cairn_field holds a claim by a marker standing, and the protocol accepts the party that can put somebody on the ground as having the better figure
attributes.where_it_is_most_used: around geography.exhausted_seam, which is the one place on the plains where two surveys disagree by more than the ordinary disagreement and which nobody will hold a claim on
attributes.what_it_costs_to_refuse: a claim made on one figure is void on the ground the moment a second figure is published, so refusing the protocol does not protect a measurement - it deletes it while leaving the other party free to republish

name: The Split Tally Law
summary: A debt evidenced by a stick broken between the two parties, each keeping half, which a court will sometimes prefer to a sealed instrument. It exists because after the Iron Grief the ground held no other record, and a split tally is the only evidence a river community can carry, dispute and destroy without a scribe.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:an instrument designed so neither party can forge it alone
authored-game-data:cultures.river_notary prefers the broken stick, and organizations.jade_writ marks a debt with a tally cut with the debtor

attributes.the_instrument: a stick split between the parting parties, each half carrying half the terms. Forgery requires both halves and therefore both parties' consent, so the instrument cannot be produced by the party it would be used against
attributes.why_it_survives_a_disaster: history.disaster_the_iron_grief left ground that held no other record, and a split tally is the only evidence a river community can carry, dispute and destroy without a scribe. That is a property of the object and not of its culture
attributes.why_a_court_prefers_it: a sealed instrument is evidence somebody wrote a claim. A split stick is evidence two people agreed in front of each other, and a court on this tier will take the second over the first whenever it can
attributes.what_it_cannot_express: anything that needs to be larger than a stick, and anything one party must be able to enforce alone. Every claim needing a third signature is written elsewhere and is therefore weaker here
attributes.what_it_is_worth_at_a_pass: a passage_livery mark is worth more than a document because it can be checked for nothing, and a split tally is the road's own evidence. organizations.jade_writ's difficulty is that a people who retire their names annually cannot hold either

name: The Assay Disclosure
summary: The measured quantity of stone left per unit of ground worked, published before any sale and never after. It has been falling for three generations, the densest bodies stop one gate short of their own tier, and because publishing the figure means nobody has to be told the reason, the disclosure is what keeps both unavailable.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:an institution that enforces silence by publishing something adjacent to the truth
authored-game-data:economy.spirit_stone_bed states the measured figure is published before any sale and nobody may sell the answer

attributes.what_is_published: the measured stone per unit of ground worked, by face, dated, posted on neutral ground before the sale opens. It is falling and everybody in the tier can read the fall
attributes.the_enforcement_substitution: a figure published before the sale cannot be disputed after it. That is the only enforcement mechanism the assay floor has, and it works by making the buyer hold the number rather than the seller
attributes.why_it_is_neutral_ground: because the buyer and the seller both need it to be true and neither can be the party who publishes it. civilizations.quarry_company underwrites the floor for exactly that reason and takes nothing from the result
attributes.the_unit: one cut length of fresh stone. The same number is the grade of a pass window and the grade of the jade ration, so the price and the schedule and the food are all one figure
attributes.what_it_excludes: any statement about why the fall is happening. A reader can compute the rate of exhaustion perfectly and cannot ask what caused it, because the cause is not measured and the measurement is the whole of what is published

name: The Published Window
summary: A crossing schedule printed a season ahead and never shortened, quoted in cut lengths of fresh stone. The holder who sets the date would be claiming the weather, so publishing the schedule is what makes the toll defensible and stops either party later claiming it was moved for them.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a schedule published so that nobody can later allege it was altered for them
authored-game-data:economy.gale_window is published a season ahead, may be shortened never, and is quoted in cut lengths of fresh spirit stone

attributes.what_is_published: hours in a season, counted on the Tidemark and never on a holder's clock, announced a season ahead. The clause that it may be shortened never is the part that makes the rest credible
attributes.what_it_is_denominated_in: one cut length of fresh spirit stone per published window, which makes the schedule and the price the same number viewed from two sides. A holder who claims not to know the price is claiming not to know the schedule
attributes.why_the_holder_does_not_set_it: a holder who sets the date sets a claim on the weather, and weather is the one thing in this setting nobody has ever successfully claimed. The publication is what removes the claim rather than what concedes the point
attributes.what_it_proves: that the window was not moved. It is the instrument that makes a schedule defensible and a prohibition not, because a prohibition has no timestamp and a schedule has one
attributes.who_it_disadvantages: the jade workers and the fire practitioners, who have no alternative route and keep working through the bad hours because a schedule can be planned around and a closure cannot

name: Cut and Cloth
summary: The cheapest credential in the setting and the one everybody actually checks: a traveller's cloth and cut say what they are and what they may open, because a world boundary is the edge of a law budget and clothing is the only credential that costs nothing to verify.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a credential optimised entirely for the cost of checking it
authored-game-data:cultures.passage_livery makes cloth and cut the credential, and organizations.jade_writ uses the cuff mark as its instrument

attributes.what_the_cut_declares: what a traveller is and what they may open. It is legible to a stranger with no literacy in the record and it survives being worn through, which a written credential does not
attributes.why_cloth_and_not_a_seal: a check must cost the checker nothing. organizations.watchgate has to seat a crowd inside a ring built from the same ore as everything else, so its one real cost is a decision somebody else has to pay for, and a stamp is a decision
attributes.who_checks_it: everyone, at every crossing, before the traveller has any standing to object. The check is cheap precisely because it is unarguable and immediate, which is the whole reason the credential survives contact with organizations.jade_writ
attributes.what_it_is_worth_at_the_gate: admission to a room. It is not worth a place on the trials, because economy.gate_fee states the ring's roster is closed by law and not by fee, so the cheapest credential in the setting does not buy the most expensive thing
attributes.what_it_does_not_prove: that the far side will accept the body. organizations.wide_door exists to sell exactly that and keeps no roster, so a cloth can be entirely legitimate and the crossing still fail

name: The Ring Seating Rumour
summary: What is said at the gate about who is attempting which gate on the Cairn Field, and the only reason a crowd with no stake in the outcome keeps paying to watch. Nobody sells the outcome, so the rumour is the product, and the gate that sells places has no interest in correcting it.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a belief sustained because correcting it would cost somebody money
authored-game-data:economy.gate_fee states the crowd has no stake in the outcome, and organizations.watchgate holds no record of who watched

attributes.what_it_is: an account of which seat is close to being filled, repeated at the gate, in the ring queue and at the town's own tables, changing every season and never once corrected
attributes.what_it_sells: the willingness to keep arriving. economy.gate_fee is the only tax the mortal tier can collect and it collects it on a crowd with no obligation on either side, so the crowd needs a reason that is not an outcome
attributes.who_propagates_it: the brokers' own queue, unintentionally, and the households who need a season's wages more than they need accuracy. There is no author and no office, which is what makes it unkillable
attributes.why_nobody_corrects_it: organizations.watchgate holds a record of who paid and none of who watched, so it cannot answer a question about an attempt. It would also be the wrong party: a settled answer is a smaller crowd
attributes.what_a_practitioner_risk_saying_in_it: the truth, once. A named practitioner who is wrong about the ring is finished as a practitioner, and the ring's outcome is not observable by anyone standing in the crowd, so no correction is ever available to be right

name: The Spiritual Bottleneck Doctrine
summary: The public account that realms three and four were a failure of will rather than a shortage of iron. It is repeated by exactly the interests whose position depends on ore being the lesser problem, so the seam was worked out before anyone thought to ask who was paying for the expedition.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a doctrine that converts a supply problem into a character problem because that is cheaper to act on
authored-game-data:history.era_the_gilded_core names metallurgy as the third gate's bottleneck, and organizations.quarrywright holds the face

attributes.what_it_claims: that a body trained properly could always have passed the third and fourth gates, and that those who could not lacked discipline. It is unfalsifiable, which is the only virtue it has
attributes.who_repeats_it: the parties whose standing depends on the alternative being unasked. organizations.quarrywright holds a working face rather than a claim, so a doctrine that makes the shortage spiritual protects the position of whoever sells the fix for it
attributes.what_it_hides: that iron is the caging medium for a forming core at all. A reader of the doctrine never learns there is a material question at the third gate, and so cannot cost it
attributes.how_to_tell_it_from_the_record: the doctrine is oral and always second-hand; the record is that economy.iron_ore_bed prices every craft, tool, container and weapon on the plains, and a shortage of will does not need tools
attributes.what_it_bought_and_cost: it bought four generations in which nobody prepared for a supply failure, and it cost history.disaster_the_iron_grief: one exhausted seam took the tier its whole ladder because a three-slot world cannot re-cut stone to find more

name: The Permanent Border Method
summary: A published system for holding the immortal border as a permanent crossing, sold for years as a seat that could be kept. It collapsed because a seat cannot be held by someone who cannot pay for it every period, and what it left was a bed of unmortared seats at realm eighteen and a border still crossed one person at a time.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a published method that sold permanence in a currency that cannot be paid forward
authored-game-data:history.collapse_the_eighteenth_bed leaves unmortared seats, and economy.immortal_essence_pool prices the top rung in periods

attributes.what_it_promised: a held crossing. organizations.bed_of_eighteen sells standing above the border and may not hold it, so the seat was the guarantee and the method was the product
attributes.why_it_failed: arithmetic before politics. Essence is not bought, it is settled every period, and a permanent crossing is a permanent debt. The seat could not be held by somebody who could not pay for it every period
attributes.what_it_left: a bed of unmortared seats at realm eighteen and no sect in possession of the border at any time since. The recovery resembles the original attempt, which is the reason the method is still published
attributes.who_still_publishes_it: parties with a claim above the border and no way to occupy it, which is most of the political surface of this setting above history.era_the_broken_bridge
attributes.what_the_road_thinks: nothing at all. economy.passage_tariff is the durable arrangement and it is one body at a time, which is the opposite of the product and is what an eighteenth-bed border actually looks like

name: The Marked Threshold
summary: Households marking their own door and renewing the mark when the frame beneath it changes, because an unwritten law has no dial and therefore no guarantee. The world will not promise welcome, so a community that needs one marks it and keeps it marked itself.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:a community substituting a self-maintained guarantee for one the world structurally cannot give
authored-game-data:cultures.door_liturgy renews the mark when the frame under it changes, and cosmology.unwritten_law has no dial to push

attributes.what_is_marked: the threshold, not the house. A mark can promise welcome and can promise nothing about the ground, which is the honest division of what a household can actually control
attributes.what_is_renewed_and_when: when the frame beneath it changes. That is the entire trigger and it is observable from outside, so the renewal is the only public record a household keeps of its own circumstances
attributes.what_the_mark_guarantees: that the household will admit a traveller who presents correctly. Nothing about whether the traveller will survive arriving, and a marked threshold may hold while the frame does not
attributes.what_it_does_not: bind the world. cultures.threshold_builders builds and then guards doors and takes as its measure that what it builds is tested from the other side, which is the guild's version and the reason the practice is guild-held rather than household-held
attributes.who_maintains_it: the household, at the cost of a guild that will test it. The mark is worth exactly what the tester finds, so the ritual and the profession are the same institution viewed from inside and outside

name: The Recovery Register
summary: The only relic a fire-affinity culture keeps: an unbroken shell and the whole recovery written down in public, with the fragments never displayed again. A great ascension is a furnace body opened on purpose, so there is no museum here - there is a register, and the register is the relic.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:an archive whose primary artefact is deliberately not exhibited
authored-game-data:cultures.ash_register records the recovery publicly and never displays the fragments again

attributes.what_is_written: the shell, the order of what was done, and every interval, read aloud at a settlement funeral. The whole of it, every time, which is what makes it an audit rather than a story
attributes.what_is_never_shown: the fragments. An ascension that is re-examined is an ascension that is repeated, and the culture's entire method is a furnace body opened once on a purpose
attributes.why_there_is_no_museum: museums display. A people whose peak act destroys the evidence cannot keep a collection of it, so it keeps the account and loses the object, and the account is the part that survives a bad decade
attributes.what_the_register_is_for: settling a question that will recur. history.disaster_the_cinder_famine proved the arithmetic, and the register is the standing answer to a household asking whether this is the year
attributes.who_may_read_it: anybody at the funeral. There is no restriction, which is unusual and is the point: the culture has nothing to protect, because the one thing worth protecting is the practice and the practice is public

name: The Long Marrow Memory
summary: The setting's only durable library: a population that keeps its archive in one body turning over at about a percent a year and living four centuries. It is also why they cannot take the body path, since hardening the bone stops the turnover the memory runs on.

provenance.author: w6-knowledge
basis: abstract-pattern:an archive substrate that the population's own strength programme would destroy
authored-game-data:races.longmarrow live four centuries on bone that turns over at about a percent a year and cannot take the body path

attributes.the_substrate: one person. qi is stored in bone that turns over at roughly a percent a year, so a memory held in marrow is a record that can be neither edited nor burned by anybody else
attributes.the_turnover_rate: about a percent a year, which is what makes the practice possible and what makes the loss total. A holder's death is not a copy being retired; it is the only copy being retired
attributes.why_the_body_path_is_closed_to_it: cultivation.body_iron_skin wins by hardening the bone, and hardening the bone stops the turnover their qi depends on. The longest-lived body in the record is built out of the one material it may never stop replacing
attributes.what_it_is_the_only_copy_of: cultures.debt_line, cultures.river_notary and every arrangement on the plains whose record is a person rather than a document. The migration up the stair took the carriers away and the institutions did not come with them
attributes.what_a_death_costs: four centuries of one archive. That is the setting's largest single loss per person and it is why the long-marrow population is valued for what they remember rather than for what they can do
